prompt: Which correctly defines a static factory method for a class Circle?
choices: class Circle { double radius; private Circle(double r) { radius = r; } public static Circle withRadius(double r) { return new Circle(r); } }
static Circle new(double r) { return Circle(r); }
class Circle { public Circle factory(double r) { return new Circle(r); } }
explanation: A static factory method: private constructor (prevents direct new), public static method that creates and returns the object. This pattern gives meaningful names (withRadius vs just 'new') and can return cached instances. Option D: factory is an instance method — needs an existing Circle to call it, defeating the purpose.
